(
	i/process
	i/fs
	i/net
	i/task
	i/core
	i/fail
	i/stdio
	i/bit_array
	std/json
	std/int
	std/list
	std/path
)

Job = (name = String, url = String)
Outcome = Success | Failure
Success = (value = Int)
Failure = ()

InputError = ()

read_manifest = (file : String) -> Result(List(Job), InputError) {
	fail.catch(() {
		bytes = fs.read_file(file)
		text = bit_array.to_string(bytes) |>
			(Ok(value)) { value }
			| (Error(_)) { fail.raise(InputError) }
		json.parse(text) |>
			(Ok(value)) { value }
			| (Error(_)) { fail.raise(InputError) }
		value |> (json.Array(jobs)) { decode_jobs(jobs) }
		| (_) { fail.raise(InputError) }
	})
}

decode_jobs = (values : List(json.Json)) -> List(Job) {
	decode_jobs_loop(values, [], [])
}

decode_jobs_loop = (values : List(json.Json), seen : List(String), out : List(Job)) -> List(Job) {
	values |> ([]) { list.reverse(out) }
		| ([value, ..rest]) {
			value |> (json.Object(_)) {
				name_json = json.field(value, "name") |> (Some(v)) { v } | (None) { fail.raise(InputError) }
				url_json = json.field(value, "url") |> (Some(v)) { v } | (None) { fail.raise(InputError) }
				name_json |> (json.Text(name)) {
					url_json |> (json.Text(url)) {
						{ valid_job_name(name) && core.not(list.contains(seen, name)) } |>
							(True) {
								decode_jobs_loop(rest, [name, ..seen], [Job(name = name, url = url), ..out])
							}
							| (False) { fail.raise(InputError) }
					}
					| (_) { fail.raise(InputError) }
				}
				| (_) { fail.raise(InputError) }
			}
			| (_) { fail.raise(InputError) }
		}
}

valid_job_name = (name : String) -> Bool {
	chars = core.codepoints(name)
	length = list.length(chars)
	{ length >= 1 && length <= 12 } &&
		first_lower(chars) &&
		list.all(chars, (char) {
			n = core.codepoint_to_int(char)
			(n >= 97 && n <= 122) || (n >= 48 && n <= 57)
		})
}

first_lower = (chars : List(UtfCodepoint)) -> Bool {
	chars |> ([first, .._]) {
		n = core.codepoint_to_int(first)
		n >= 97 && n <= 122
	}
	| ([]) { False }
}

parse_integer_token = (text : String) -> Result(Int, Nil) {
	int.parse(text) |> (Ok(value)) {
		canonical = int.to_string(value)
		{ canonical == text || text == "+" <> canonical } |>
			(True) { Ok(value) }
			| (False) { Error(Nil) }
	}
	| (Error(_)) { Error(Nil) }
}

decode_response = (text : String) -> Result(Int, Nil) {
	json.parse(text) |> (Ok(value)) {
		value |> (json.Object(_)) {
			json.field(value, "value") |>
				(Some(json.Text(token))) {
					parse_integer_token(token) |> (Ok(number)) {
						{ number >= -1000 && number <= 1000 } |>
							(True) { Ok(number) }
							| (False) { Error(Nil) }
					}
					| (Error(_)) { Error(Nil) }
				}
				| (_) { Error(Nil) }
		}
		| (_) { Error(Nil) }
	}
	| (Error(_)) { Error(Nil) }
}

remove_part = (output : String, name : String) {
	part_file = path.join([output, name <> ".part"])
	fail.catch(() { fs.remove(part_file) })
	Nil
}

process_job = (job : Job, output : String) -> Outcome {
	part = path.join([output, job.name <> ".part"])
	target = path.join([output, job.name <> ".txt"])
	fail.catch(() {
		job.url |> ("bad-url") { fail.raise(InputError) } | (_) { Nil }
		fail.raise(InputError)
	}) |>
		(Ok(_)) { remove_part(output, job.name)  Failure }
		| (Error(_)) { remove_part(output, job.name)  Failure }
}

run_jobs = (jobs : List(Job), output : String) -> List(String) {
	task.map_concurrently(jobs, (job) {
		result = process_job(job, output)
		result |>
			(Success(value)) { "OK " <> job.name <> " " <> int.to_string(value) }
			| (Failure) { "ERROR " <> job.name }
	})
}

main = () {
	args = process.args()
	args |> ([manifest, output]) {
		read_manifest(manifest) |>
			(Ok(jobs)) {
				lock = path.join([output, ".batchlock"])
				lock_result = fail.catch(() { fs.mkdir(lock) })
				lock_result |>
					(Ok(_)) {
						results = run_jobs(jobs, output)
						fail.catch(() { fs.remove(lock) })
						list.each(results, stdio.print)
						stdio.print("DONE " <> int.to_string(list.length(jobs)))
					}
					| (Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR LOCK") }
			}
			| (Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
	}
	| (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
}
